q: How do I allocate a mall's common-area electricity to my store?
title: Mall common-area electricity share
short: Ask the mall for the common-area electricity in kWh and the total leasable area, then take your store's share by area and multiply by 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25. For a tenant it is Scope 3, Category 8; the operator reports the whole common area in its Scope 2.
audience: Retail tenants in malls and the mall operators who bill them

sections.h: What the mall should give you
ul: Common-area kWh for the period, from its bills.
Total leasable area and your area from the lease.
Diesel for common-area generators, if any.

p: Area share is the usual basis and matches how service charges are billed. Use it every year so figures stay comparable, and say so in your method note.
Your own metered electricity is Scope 2. The common-area share is Scope 3, Category 8, upstream leased assets, because the mall runs that space.

example.title: Worked example: one store's common-area share (one month, illustrative inputs)
lines: Common-area electricity: 60,000 kWh x 0.710 = 42,600 kg CO2
Your store: 4,000 sq ft of 200,000 sq ft leasable area = 2 percent
Your share: 42,600 x 0.02 = 852 kg CO2, reported in Scope 3, Category 8
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use the mall's statement of common-area units.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
